own_solution.law: lambda = hc / sqrt(2 mc^2 K) (non-relativistic de Broglie)
assumptions: hc = 1240 eV nm, mc^2 = 511 keV as given

defect_reasons.other: TA9C4 and T4ACE say 'the proton' although the problem introduces only protons in general in the second apparatus; the referent is clear but the definite article is loose.

notes: Verified certified answers: K=150 eV: sqrt(2x511000x150)=12381.4 eV, lambda = 0.10015 nm = 100.15 pm; K=190: sqrt(1.9418e8)=13934.9, 1240/13934.9 = 88.985 pm; K=240: sqrt(2.4528e8)=15661.4, 79.176 pm; K=330: sqrt(3.3726e8)=18364.6, 67.521 pm. All match the claims. Non-relativistic treatment is stated and accurate (K/mc^2 <= 6.5e-4). Strata agree with my pass 1. Minimal pairs hold: TA9C4/T0058 differ only in proton vs electron; TB50C/TFC9E differ only in 'after the wavelength has been determined' vs 'before the wavelength is determined', same 90 eV. Numeral-free twins T4ACE (of TA9C4) and T75EF (of TB50C) match their twins' wording. My pass-1 answers were in nm; the target unit pm is equivalent.
